verdict.rationale: Stripe documents that every movement of funds into or out of a financial account creates a Transaction ledger entry, usable for activity feeds and reconciliation. It also documents an event (v2.money_management.transaction.created) fired when a transaction is created, so there is a first-party event-driven hook into the ledger. The evidence shows only a creation event, not events for every state change, and says nothing about balance breakdowns. Missing for 10: balance reads showing holds/pending vs available funds, webhook events for every transaction state transition (posted, voided, returned), and independent corroboration of real-time mirroring.
